question: Is the Eiffel Tower taller than the Statue of Liberty, and is the Eiffel Tower located in Paris?

paragraphs.title: Eiffel Tower
paragraphs.paragraph: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is 330 metres tall.

paragraphs.title: Statue of Liberty
paragraphs.paragraph: The Statue of Liberty is a colossal neoclassical sculpture on Liberty Island in New York Harbor. The height from the base to the torch is 46 metres.

question: Did Ada Lovelace and Alan Turing both work at the University of Cambridge?

paragraphs.title: Ada Lovelace
paragraphs.paragraph: Ada Lovelace was an English mathematician and writer, chiefly known for her work on Charles Babbage's proposed mechanical general-purpose computer, the Analytical Engine.

paragraphs.title: Alan Turing
paragraphs.paragraph: Alan Turing was an English mathematician, computer scientist, and cryptanalyst. He studied at King's College, Cambridge and later worked at the University of Manchester.
